name: NoLoadingScreen
description: Removes the loading screens from joining a world. "Loading terrain" and "Reconfiguring" are replaced by the world itself — or, while none exists yet, by a void with a free camera — so a join is something to look at rather than a panel to sit through. No protocol packet is fabricated, dropped or reordered; loading-time packet handling is spread across frames, so handling and replies may occur later.
